field_principles.adoption_rows: Every promoted method names one bounded existing experiment hook.
field_principles.arxiv_rows: Primary-paper rows preserve canonical identity, date, and bounded claims.
field_principles.candidate_rows: A closed disposition prevents an interesting lead from silently becoming work.
field_principles.claim_boundary_rows: Each item states what its source cannot establish for Carnot.
field_principles.deduplication_rows: Canonical suppression stops rediscovery from appearing novel.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured duration distinguishes an executed audit from a template.
field_principles.execution_venue: The venue separates host execution from unavailable hardware claims.
field_principles.extropic_rows: Vendor hardware projections stay separate from attached-hardware evidence.
field_principles.field_principles: One principle per field makes the scientific contract reviewable.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Exact expected and observed values make a blocked run actionable.
field_principles.github_rows: Repository activity and licenses identify code but do not prove quality.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A class-matched terminal prefix gives automation one unambiguous outcome.
field_principles.huggingface_papers_rows: Paper-feed rows remain discovery signals below primary papers.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The declared substrate limits the work to a bounded network audit.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: The compute class states that the sweep loads no model.
field_principles.logical_intelligence_rows: Kona remains a product comparator without public reproducibility.
field_principles.openreview_rows: Challenge responses remain access receipts rather than inferred content.
field_principles.per_game_results: An empty game ledger states that literature review measured no game outcome.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Explicit gates prevent unavailable sources from becoming fabricated results.
field_principles.primary_source_receipts: Each candidate traces to a primary paper or official project page.
field_principles.query_rows: Exact queries disclose coverage without converting search rank into evidence.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed seed records deterministic ordering even though no sampling occurs.
field_principles.references_append_hash: The final ledger hash proves byte stability for an empty delta.
field_principles.references_append_path: The declared ledger path makes the only permitted documentation write explicit.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A stable payload hash detects any evidence or verdict change.
field_principles.rows: A combined ledger permits independent collection-consistency checks.
field_principles.search_window: An explicit window makes freshness and exclusion decisions falsifiable.
field_principles.semantic_scholar_rows: Visible citation rows are index observations, not scientific authority.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Hashes bind the result to the local planning evidence that was read.
field_principles.source_class_rows: Every requested source class ends in an honest dated receipt.
field_principles.v622_sota_ingestion_complete_score: One means source coverage and every promotion boundary passed.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed terminal class prevents outages or invalid rows from reading positive.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False states that source review cannot certify Carnot correctness.
